name: a-token-without-ads-read-still-orients
rule: When ad accounts cannot be read, orientation still returns the Pages and says what is missing. It must never become an error.
why: T-21. Orientation is the call a model makes before it knows what it needs; failing it outright over a missing scope strands the caller at the first step with no way to discover the half that does work. The degraded answer names the scope instead.
